import pandas as pd

def clean(df):
    # Remove exact duplicate rows
    df = df.drop_duplicates()
    
    # Fix island column by stripping whitespace
    df = df.copy()
    df['island'] = df['island'].str.strip()
    
    # Convert body_mass_g from text to numeric, removing commas
    df['body_mass_g'] = df['body_mass_g'].str.replace(',', '').astype(float)
    
    # Remove negative flipper_length_mm (invalid)
    df.loc[df['flipper_length_mm'] < 0, 'flipper_length_mm'] = pd.NA
    
    # Remove body_mass_g values out of range (2500-6500)
    df.loc[(df['body_mass_g'] < 2500) | (df['body_mass_g'] > 6500), 'body_mass_g'] = pd.NA
    
    return df

def answer(df):
    df_clean = clean(df)
    # Drop rows where sex or body_mass_g is missing
    df_clean = df_clean.dropna(subset=['sex', 'body_mass_g'])
    result = df_clean.groupby('sex')['body_mass_g'].mean().round(2).to_dict()
    return result
